title: M37 Trend core golden vector
description: Language-neutral parity cases for the Trend core (docs/designs/progress-overview.md, D5). Each case names one function and gives its arguments by parameter name in `input` and its full return value in `expected`. metric_trend skips every Reading whose value is null or not finite, sorts the rest by (at, id) with ids in code-unit order, and returns one point per kept Reading: the first trend equals its value, and each later trend is trend[i-1] + a * (value[i] - trend[i-1]) with a = 1 - 0.9 ^ days, where days is the time since the previous kept Reading in milliseconds divided by 86 400 000. JSON has no non-finite numbers, so an input value may be the string "NaN", "Infinity" or "-Infinity", which runners decode to the IEEE value before calling the core. Instants are ISO-8601 UTC strings. Runners compare every `trend` field within the file's top-level `tolerance` (pow can differ in the last bit between Dart and JavaScript) and everything else exactly.

oneOf.description: A non-finite value, which JSON cannot spell as a number.

note.description: Why the case exists and which rule it pins. Runners ignore it.
